say.text: Last, Isa went to Ain ad-Dawla al-Yaruqi, the chief of the emirs, who had more troops than all the rest. On him he used every argument he had, and used them in vain.
No. I will never serve under Yusuf.
Al-Yaruqi went back to Nur ad-Din with his men, and some other emirs went with him. Nur ad-Din blamed him for leaving Egypt; but it was done.
